description: This Java source file defines a class 'HonoHttpDevice' which simulates an HTTP device for Hono platform. It constructs and sends various telemetry and event messages over HTTP, with mechanisms for handling responses, including command signals. The class encapsulates request types, handling HTTP communication, and simulating device behavior for testing or demonstration purposes.

classes.name: HonoHttpDevice
classes.description: A class that simulates an HTTP device for Hono platform, capable of sending different types of messages (events and telemetry) over HTTP and handling responses.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that creates an instance of HonoHttpDevice and initiates data sending.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends an individual message request to the Hono HTTP adapter, handling response and potential command signals.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Sends a response to a command request identified by commandReqId.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Sequentially sends predefined requests (events and telemetry) to the Hono platform.

methods.name: getBasicAuth
methods.description: Constructs a Basic Authentication header value for a device.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Creates a device authentication identifier from device ID and tenant.
